peer_identity.arc_label: Loyal companion and southern assault commander who dies at Marmola
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Loyal subordinate to Othon; twin of Hohenhole. Executed the southern assault via secret tunnels. Body recovered by Othon as a mark of honor. Not directly quoted in surviving pages.
peer_identity.rationale: Both records clearly describe the same person: a warrior in Othon's household who appears near a white cubic structure in vol01 and leads the southern tunnel assault and dies at Marmola in vol02. Twin of Hohenhole. Thin records, no contradictory facts.
